result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under the names they were written with, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops the zip or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or an export with a renamed aspect.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The export now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose text files. It then reads that file and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default configuration the entries are the same five names in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The old failure was the read of the missing `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, which threw before `git-history.zip` was reached, so that zip is written again too.
